title: Gideon's Death and Israel's Apostasy
description: After the victory over Midian, the land had rest for forty years. Gideon had seventy sons by his many wives, and a concubine in Shechem bore him Abimelech. Gideon died at an old age and was buried in Ophrah. After his death, Israel turned away from the Lord, worshiped Baal-Berith, and showed no loyalty to Gideon's house. [ref:Judg 8:28-35|Judges 8:28-35]
